% scripts/resume-template.tex
% Resume Template
%
% Author: Edward Silva
% Creation Date: 07 November, 2026
% Last Update: 08 November, 2026
%
% The fixed part of the resume, based on information/.agents/docs/templates/template.tex: XCharter, pdflatex, Unicode
% mapping for applicant tracking systems, PDF metadata, and bookmarks. scripts/build-resume.js
% copies it next to two generated files before each compile: settings.tex holds the font size,
% margins, and spacing for one layout, and body.tex holds the metadata and content.
%
% File Structure:
% - Packages and page setup
% - Section and list style, with the spacing read from settings.tex
% - Measurement macro the fitting script reads from the log
%
% Where this file is used within the repository:
% - Compiled by scripts/build-resume.js
%
% Usage:
% $ `npm run build:resume` : Fits and compiles the resume
%
% Copyright (c) 2026 Edward Silva. All rights reserved.
% NOTICE: This file contains personal biographical data.
% It is strictly excluded from the repository's MIT License and
% may not be reproduced, distributed, or modified without permission.

\documentclass[11pt]{article}
\input{settings}
\usepackage[letterpaper,margin=\resumemargin]{geometry}
\usepackage{XCharter}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage[utf8]{inputenc}
\usepackage{enumitem}
\usepackage[hidelinks]{hyperref}
\usepackage{bookmark}
\usepackage{titlesec}
\usepackage[protrusion=true,expansion=true]{microtype}
\raggedright
\raggedbottom
\pagestyle{empty}
\urlstyle{same}
\setlength{\parindent}{0pt}
\setlength{\parskip}{0pt}

% No hyphenated line breaks: a word split across lines cannot be found by a keyword search.
\hyphenpenalty=10000
\exhyphenpenalty=10000

% Every glyph maps to real Unicode text, so the PDF stays machine-readable.
\input{glyphtounicode}
\pdfgentounicode=1

% One gap size between every pair of sections, grown with the rest of the spacing.
\titleformat{\section}{\bfseries\large}{}{0pt}{}[\vspace{2pt}\titlerule]
\titlespacing*{\section}{0pt}{\sectiongap}{\sectionafter}

\renewcommand\labelitemi{$\vcenter{\hbox{\small$\bullet$}}$}
\setlist[itemize]{leftmargin=12pt,topsep=\listtop,itemsep=\listitem,parsep=0pt,partopsep=0pt}

% The fitting script reads this line from the log after each compile.
\newcommand{\measure}[1]{%
  \typeout{RESUME-#1 page=\thepage\space used=\the\pagetotal\space
    goal=\the\pagegoal\space line=\the\baselineskip}}

\begin{document}
\resumefont
\thispagestyle{empty}
\input{body}
\par\measure{END}
\end{document}
